fit_reason: This is a trailer-only listing (a new car hauler trailer), and the photos show a dealer lot full of trailer inventory, so it is dealer stock rather than a private owner selling a vehicle we detail.

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lamar car hauler. It looks brand new with a clean deck and finish, so it doesn't need a detail right now. If you ever have a car, truck or boat you'd like cleaned up before a sale, we come to you. Would you like us to keep your info for a future quote?
